AI Website Analysis & Prototype Generation

A pipeline for extracting website content, comparing features and generating multi-page website prototypes.

Context
Xeropex / 2025–2026
Technology
PHPLaravelWeb scrapingAI integration
Source
Private business code
My roleTechnical approachResultDemonstration & evidence

The problem

Showing a prospective customer a proposed website can require considerable work before there is an agreement. Xeropex wanted a way to explore possible improvements and produce a testable visual starting point.

My role

I developed the workflow for collecting website information, comparing it with a configurable feature list and connecting that context to AI-generated website files.

Technical approach

The pipeline used website input and extracted content to inventory existing features and identify gaps against a desired feature list. I worked on the prompts and file processing needed to generate a prototype with multiple pages. I also explored batch processing as a trade-off between cost and completion time.

Challenges & decisions

Generating the appearance of a feature is different from implementing its backend behaviour. Multi-page output also needs consistent navigation and shared assets. The generated result should therefore be reviewed as a prototype, with simulated interactions identified before further development.

Result

A downloadable example from the original portfolio contains 28 HTML pages and accompanying assets. It demonstrates multi-page generation and gives a concrete starting point for discussing a website redesign.

How the pieces connect

  1. Website input
  2. Content extraction
  3. Feature comparison
  4. AI generation
  5. Multi-page prototype

Simplified conceptual workflow. Not an exact internal architecture.

Demonstration & evidence

The original portfolio states that Xeropex allowed this generated example to be shared. Download and extract the ZIP, then open index.html. Some interactions are simulated; the example has no production backend.
